type Raw string

const CommandClassRead
const CommandClassReveal

func (CommandClass) IsKnown() bool
func (CommandClass) Known() bool

type ContextRef struct
  Instance string
  Context string
  Epoch string
type ContextEntry struct
  Context ContextRef
  Title string
  Revision string
type ContextPage struct
  Outcome ReadingOutcome
  Contexts []ContextEntry
  Reason string
type KindField struct
  Name string
  Role FieldRole
type Kind struct
  Name string
  Title string
  Schema Raw
  Fields []KindField
type Entity struct
  ID string
  Kind string
  Label string
  Parent string
  Properties Raw
type Collection struct
  Parent string
  Kind string
  IDs []string
type Selection struct
  View string
  Entities []string
  Focus string
type ContextSnapshot struct
  Outcome ReadingOutcome
  Context ContextRef
  Revision string
  Entities []Entity
  Collections []Collection
  Selections []Selection
  Cursor string
  Reason string
type ReadRequest struct
  Context ContextRef
  Entities []string
  Cursor string
  Limit int64
type Change struct
  BaseRevision string
  Revision string
  Patch Raw
type ChangesRequest struct
  Context ContextRef
  AfterRevision string
  WaitMs int64
type ChangeBatch struct
  Outcome ReadingOutcome
  Context ContextRef
  Changes []Change
  Revision string
  Reason string
type CommandSpec struct
  Name string
  Title string
  Description string
  Class CommandClass
  InputSchema Raw
  OutputSchema Raw
  Targets []string
  Proposable bool
  Undoable bool
  Idempotent bool
  LongRunning bool
type ContextBounds struct
  SnapshotBytes int64
  ChangeBytes int64
  RetainedRevisions int64
  PendingProposals int64
  CallsInFlight int64
type Description struct
  Version string
  Kinds []Kind
  Commands []CommandSpec
  Extensions []string
  Bounds ContextBounds
type DescriptionResult struct
  Outcome ReadingOutcome
  Description *Description
  Reason string
type Invocation struct
  Context ContextRef
  Arguments Raw
  Mode InvokeMode
  ExpectedRevision string
  IdempotencyKey string
  Proposal string
type CommandResult struct
  Outcome CommandOutcome
  Reason string
  Revision string
  Proposal string
  Summary string
  Job string
  Effects Raw
  UndoGroup string
  IdempotencyKey string
type Reveal struct
  Context ContextRef
  Entities []string
  Style RevealStyle
type UndoRequest struct
  Context ContextRef
  UndoGroup string
  ExpectedRevision string
  IdempotencyKey string
type JobRequest struct
  Instance string
  Job string
type DeclaredCommand struct
  Name string
  Class CommandClass
type CommandDeclaration struct
  Version string
  Commands []DeclaredCommand
type ApplicationsQuery struct
  Application string
type ListedInstance struct
  Instance string
  Interface string
  Contexts []ContextEntry
  Reason string
type ListedApplication struct
  Application string
  Title string
  Instances []ListedInstance
type ListedOpenVerb struct
  Name string
  Description string
  InputSchema Raw
type ApplicationOpenVerbs struct
  Application string
  Verbs []ListedOpenVerb
type ApplicationListing struct
  Outcome ReadingOutcome
  Applications []ListedApplication
  Reason string
  OpenVerbs []ApplicationOpenVerbs
type CommandsQuery struct
  Application string
  Instance string
type CommandListing struct
  Outcome ReadingOutcome
  Application string
  Instance string
  Commands []CommandSpec
  Reason string
type GatewayCall struct
  Application string
  Instance string
  Tool string
  Arguments Raw
  Mode *InvokeMode
  ExpectedRevision string
  IdempotencyKey string
  Context string
  Proposal string
  RequireReadPermit *bool
type CallRecord struct
  Subject string
  ClientLabel string
  Application string
  Instance string
  Context *ContextRef
  Command string
  Class *CommandClass
  RevisionBefore string
  RevisionAfter string
  Outcome string
  Reason string
  IdempotencyKey string
  ArgumentsDigest string
  ResultDigest string
type Envelope struct
  Description *DescriptionResult
  Contexts *ContextPage
  Read *ReadRequest
  Snapshot *ContextSnapshot
  ChangesRequest *ChangesRequest
  Changes *ChangeBatch
  Invocation *Invocation
  Result *CommandResult
  Reveal *Reveal
  Undo *UndoRequest
  Job *JobRequest
  Declaration *CommandDeclaration
  Record *CallRecord
  ApplicationsQuery *ApplicationsQuery
  Applications *ApplicationListing
  CommandsQuery *CommandsQuery
  Commands *CommandListing
  Call *GatewayCall
func Encode(v *Envelope) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Envelope, error)

func FromJSON(data []byte, v any) error
